text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'S2 placebo: 240 intervals of 6 to 72 hours at six substations, each given a donor's real power with a true share of zero. Dot: one interval. Black tick: 95th percentile of the absolute recovered share for the donor. Dashed rule: the pre-registered limit of 0.10 for that percentile. Donors are sorted by mean absolute power over September 2023 to June 2026.'
text.tspan: S2 placebo: 240 intervals of 6 to 72 hours at six substations, each given a donor's real
power with a true share of zero. Dot: one interval. Black tick: 95th percentile of the
absolute recovered share for the donor. Dashed rule: the pre-registered limit of 0.10 for
that percentile. Donors are sorted by mean absolute power over September 2023 to June 2026.
